# culipulse_agents (Data Source)

Lists the agents (checkpoints) your monitors can check from: CuliPulse's shared agents and your own. Use `ids` to fill a monitor's `agent_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# CuliPulse's shared agents in Europe.
data "culipulse_agents" "eu" {
  kind   = "first_party"
  region = "eu"
}

# Agents you run yourself.
data "culipulse_agents" "own" {
  kind = "tenant"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) `first_party` for CuliPulse's shared agents, `tenant` for agents you run yourself.
- `region` (String) Only return agents in this region. Shared CuliPulse agents use `sg`, `eu`, `na`, `au`; your own agents use whatever region you gave them.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) The matching agents, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching agents, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Agent id.
- `kind` (String) `first_party` or `tenant`.
- `last_seen_at` (Number) When the agent last checked in (Unix seconds).
- `name` (String) Agent name.
- `region` (String) Region label.
- `version` (String) Agent software version.
